fields.Name: W7 -> S4.2 #2
fields.Description: Gate G2.5 (phase 2, dataset W7, criterion S4.2 #2): on W7-small-imbalanced s42–s44, the gate returns `model` for 0 of 3 seeds whose holdout AUC interval contains 0.5 or whose minority class has < 20 rows (T7; 2 of 3 published today). Each seed trains through MJAPI and the check reads the gate record stored on the run: no seed may ship anything while its stored minority count is below the protocol minimum, nor a model whose AUC interval contains 0.5; every seed must store its guard inputs (on W7 a minority count below 20) and both bounds on every stored number. Measured on seeds 42–61: every seed's minority class has 2–9 rows and every transcribed decision is already no-signal, so no W7 seed reaches the guards with a shipping outcome and the runtime gate cannot exercise the demotion; the guard demotion is Core's gate.test.ts (GateRules.ApplyGateGuards). The mutation is therefore a substitute: it fails when GateRules.ApplyGateGuards drops the minority-class guard (model on a seed with < 20 minority rows), measured on Core's gate.test.ts guard cases.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 3 of 3 W7 seeds store a gate record with a minority below 20 and no shipped outcome, 0 guard violations, 0 stored numbers without bounds.
